transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we begin our review of the proposed investment in the GreenBridge Renewable Infrastructure Credit Fund, I'd like to follow our standard pre-commitment process. We know the fund invests in senior secured loans to operating renewable-energy projects and has reported positive performance for the past three years. The investment window closes on June 30, 2026, so we have time, but I want to be thorough. I'd like to hear from portfolio risk, fund operations, and compliance before we move to a vote. Could each of you share any relevant conditions or concerns you've identified? Let's start with portfolio risk.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a portfolio risk condition to flag. This morning I recalculated our firm's existing exposure to infrastructure credit and found that our portfolio policy permits no more than a $6,500,000 additional commitment to GreenBridge. I received the updated exposure file today, but it has not yet been added to the committee packet, so I want to make sure everyone is aware of this limit before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a fund operations condition to share. I confirmed with GreenBridge's administrator this week that the first capital draw on this commitment may not exceed $1,500,000 and requires 10 business days' advance notice. The administrator's confirmation is still in my operations inbox, but I wanted to make sure the committee is aware of these operational constraints before we proceed to a vote.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a compliance condition to raise. In reviewing the fund's latest limited-partner side-letter package this week, I found that the investor must require exclusions for thermal coal and Arctic drilling, and we are entitled to receive a look-through portfolio report within 45 days after each quarter. However, I want to flag that this side letter has not yet been logged in our compliance register, so we need to complete that step before any commitment is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A4
